data.body: Headline: 221 bug tickets (7–21 Aug 2026) analysed, 196 real, 56 git-dated to in-window changes (ticket prose labels wrong 43/196). Today's reviewer re-run on 3 introducing changes blocks 1/3 and finds the defect in 2/3; the lever is routing, not thresholds. Bug-fix escalation backtest (641 fixes): no diff-computed complexity signal beats the 150-line floor; repeat-fix (same file bug-fixed >=2x in prior 7 days) catches 17/29 at 37% escalation. Report: https://claude.ai/code/artifact/d228dd86-85f6-4f50-a4e3-3a1aa0dc2706
